{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module EmailService where

import Data.Text (Text)
import qualified Data.Text as T
import qualified Data.Text.IO as TIO
import Data.Map.Strict (Map)
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.IORef
import System.IO
import Text.Printf (printf, hPrintf)
import Data.Maybe (fromMaybe)

-- Feature flag configuration
data FeatureFlags = FeatureFlags
  { ffEnableTemplating :: Bool
  , ffEnableLogging    :: Bool
  , ffLogFormat        :: LogFormat
  , ffSanitizeInputs  :: Bool
  } deriving (Show)

data LogFormat = Structured | Legacy deriving (Show, Eq)

data EmailRequest = EmailRequest
  { erTo      :: Text
  , erFrom    :: Text
  , erSubject :: Text
  , erBody    :: Text
  , erHeaders :: Map Text Text
  } deriving (Show)

data EmailContext = EmailContext
  { ecFlags    :: FeatureFlags
  , ecLogHandle :: Handle
  , ecAuditRef :: IORef [Text]
  }

-- Default production flags
defaultFlags :: FeatureFlags
defaultFlags = FeatureFlags
  { ffEnableTemplating = True
  , ffEnableLogging    = True
  , ffLogFormat        = Structured
  , ffSanitizeInputs  = True
  }

-- Sanitization layer
sanitizeField :: FeatureFlags -> Text -> Text
sanitizeField flags input
  | ffSanitizeInputs flags = T.filter (\c -> c /= '%' && c /= '\\') input
  | otherwise              = input

-- Template expansion for email bodies
expandTemplate :: Map Text Text -> Text -> Text
expandTemplate vars template =
  Map.foldlWithKey' (\acc k v -> T.replace (T.concat ["{{", k, "}}"]) v acc) template vars

-- Core logging function - writes audit trail
logEmailEvent :: EmailContext -> Text -> Text -> IO ()
logEmailEvent ctx eventType details = do
  let flags = ecFlags ctx
      handle = ecLogHandle ctx
  case ffLogFormat flags of
    Structured -> do
      TIO.hPutStrLn handle $ T.concat ["[EMAIL_EVENT] type=", eventType, " details=", details]
    Legacy -> do
      -- Legacy format uses printf-style for backward compatibility
      -- with older log aggregation systems
      let fmtStr = T.unpack $ T.concat ["[%s] ", details]
      hPrintf handle fmtStr (T.unpack eventType)
      hPutStrLn handle ""

-- Validation layer
validateEmail :: Text -> Either Text Text
validateEmail addr
  | T.null addr = Left "Empty address"
  | not (T.isInfixOf "@" addr) = Left "Invalid email format"
  | T.length addr > 254 = Left "Address too long"
  | otherwise = Right addr

-- Header injection check
checkHeaderInjection :: Map Text Text -> Either Text (Map Text Text)
checkHeaderInjection headers =
  if any (\v -> T.isInfixOf "\r\n" v || T.isInfixOf "\n" v) (Map.elems headers)
    then Left "Header injection detected"
    else Right headers

-- Process and send email
processEmail :: EmailContext -> EmailRequest -> Map Text Text -> IO (Either Text ())
processEmail ctx req templateVars = do
  let flags = ecFlags ctx
  -- Step 1: Validate
  case validateEmail (erTo req) of
    Left err -> return $ Left err
    Right validTo -> do
      case checkHeaderInjection (erHeaders req) of
        Left err -> return $ Left err
        Right safeHeaders -> do
          -- Step 2: Apply sanitization based on feature flags
          let sanitizedSubject = sanitizeField flags (erSubject req)
          let sanitizedBody = sanitizeField flags (erBody req)
          
          -- Step 3: Template expansion (after sanitization)
          let finalBody = if ffEnableTemplating flags
                          then expandTemplate templateVars sanitizedBody
                          else sanitizedBody
          
          -- Step 4: Log the event
          when (ffEnableLogging flags) $ do
            logEmailEvent ctx "SEND" (erSubject req)
          
          -- Step 5: "Send" (write to handle as simulation)
          TIO.hPutStrLn (ecLogHandle ctx) $ T.concat
            [ "To: ", validTo, "\n"
            , "From: ", erFrom req, "\n"
            , "Subject: ", sanitizedSubject, "\n"
            , "\n"
            , finalBody
            ]
          
          -- Step 6: Audit
          modifyIORef' (ecAuditRef ctx) (T.concat ["sent:", validTo] :)
          return $ Right ()

when :: Bool -> IO () -> IO ()
when True action = action
when False _     = return ()

-- Configuration override for A/B testing
applyOverrides :: FeatureFlags -> Map Text Text -> FeatureFlags
applyOverrides base overrides =
  let getFlag k def = fromMaybe def (Map.lookup k overrides >>= parseBool)
      getLogFmt = case Map.lookup "log_format" overrides of
                    Just "legacy" -> Legacy
                    _             -> ffLogFormat base
  in base
    { ffEnableTemplating = getFlag "templating" (ffEnableTemplating base)
    , ffEnableLogging    = getFlag "logging" (ffEnableLogging base)
    , ffLogFormat        = getLogFmt
    , ffSanitizeInputs  = getFlag "sanitize" (ffSanitizeInputs base)
    }

parseBool :: Text -> Maybe Bool
parseBool "true"  = Just True
parseBool "false" = Just False
parseBool "1"     = Just True
parseBool "0"     = Just False
parseBool _       = Nothing

-- Entry point for the service handler
handleEmailRequest :: Handle -> Map Text Text -> EmailRequest -> Map Text Text -> IO (Either Text ())
handleEmailRequest logH flagOverrides req templateVars = do
  auditRef <- newIORef []
  let flags = applyOverrides defaultFlags flagOverrides
      ctx = EmailContext flags logH auditRef
  processEmail ctx req templateVars
